inventory.title: Inventory

library.empty: No images yet — upload the first one
library.confirm_delete: Delete this image from the library permanently?

push.title: New order notifications
push.subtitle: Get a notification on this phone for every new order

wallet.card_note: You'll go to the secure payment page and come back here

binance.hint: Transaction ID in Binance: Pay → History.
binance.error: Couldn't verify the transaction, try again

binance.calc_label: How much do you want to top up? (DA)

binance.hint_bsc: ID in Binance: Withdraw History → Internal transfer.

profit.empty: No orders or ads in this period

ads.title: Ads
ads.subtitle: Daily ad spend for the profit calculation

abandoned.hint: Customers who typed their phone in the order form but didn't finish (at least 30 min ago). Call them — some will order.
abandoned.banner: {{count}} abandoned order(s) — customers to call back

meta.need_rate: Enter the dollar rate so spend is counted in dinars
